name: Card
summary: Layout container with tokenized surface, border, radius, shadow, media/body/footer anatomy, hover lift, and flat/elevated variants.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Card container that owns surface, border, radius, shadow, and hover lift.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Optional media region for images or visual content.

anatomy.name: mediaImage
anatomy.description: Optional image inside the media region.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional footer region for actions or secondary metadata.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Default card with subtle border and shadow.

variants.name: flat
variants.description: Flat card with no border or shadow.

variants.name: elevated
variants.description: Elevated card with stronger default shadow.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state with lift and stronger shadow.

states.name: mediaHover
states.description: Optional media image scale on card hover.

states.name: flatHover
states.description: Flat variant hover state without lift or shadow.

states.name: elevatedHover
states.description: Elevated variant hover state with stronger shadow.

behavior.name: semanticContainer
behavior.description: Consumers choose article, section, aside, list item, or another element that matches the card's content purpose.

behavior.name: contentComposition
behavior.description: Media, body content, headings, metadata, and actions are consumer-owned composition rather than Card defaults.

behavior.name: interactionBoundary
behavior.description: Targets avoid wrapping the entire card in one interactive element when nested controls are present.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Surface and elevation treatment for the card container.

accessibility: Use semantic HTML appropriate to the card purpose, such as article, section, aside, or list item.
Images inside card media must include meaningful alt text or empty alt text when decorative.
Do not make an entire card clickable if it contains nested interactive controls.
Preserve heading hierarchy inside card content.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render semantic containers with card classes.
